headline: Tragedy in NY: Son dies saving mother from horse carriage fall
summary: A young man lost his life in a heartbreaking accident in New York City while attempting to rescue his mother who had fallen from a horse-drawn carriage.
details: A tragic accident occurred in New York City when a young man died while trying to save his mother who had fallen from a horse-drawn carriage.
The incident took place during a sightseeing tour of the city, turning a family outing into a tragedy.
The son's quick reaction to help his mother in distress caused the accident that led to his death.
Local authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the carriage accident to determine the cause of the fall.
